description: Source file implementing a radio session using UHD (USRP Hardware Driver), including functions for setting time, locking sensors, configuring gains and frequencies, starting/stopping streams, and device initialization.

classes.name: radio_session_uhd_impl
classes.description: Implements a radio session using UHD, managing device configuration, stream control, and synchronization.

methods.name: set_time_to_gps_time
methods.description: Sets the USRP device time to GPS time by reading the 'gps_time' sensor.

methods.name: wait_sensor_locked
methods.description: Waits until a specified sensor (e.g., 'ref_locked' or 'gps_locked') indicates a locked state or timeout occurs.

methods.name: set_tx_gain_unprotected
methods.description: Sets the transmit gain for a specified port index.

methods.name: set_rx_gain_unprotected
methods.description: Sets the receive gain for a specified port index.

methods.name: set_tx_freq
methods.description: Configures the transmit frequency for a given port index.

methods.name: set_rx_freq
methods.description: Configures the receive frequency for a given port index.

methods.name: start_rx_stream
methods.description: Starts all receive streams at a specified initial time.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all transmit and receive streams.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts all transmit and receive streams at a specified initial time.

methods.name: read_current_time
methods.description: Retrieves the current device time in ticks.

methods.name: set_tx_freq
methods.description: Sets the transmit frequency for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: set_rx_freq
methods.description: Sets the receive frequency for a specific stream ID.
